ratios.quote: The primary financial covenants under the Credit Agreement consist of a maximum consolidated net leverage ratio of 3.0 to 1.0, which can be increased to 3.5 to 1.0 for a period of four consecutive quarters in the event of a Permitted Acquisition (as defined in the Credit Agreement) exceeding $ 25.0 million (subject to a maximum of three permitted increases), and a minimum consolidated interest coverage ratio of 2.5 to 1.0.

parsed.notes: Actual ratios are not disclosed; the filing states only that CRA was in compliance as of October 3, 2026. The 3.0x net leverage maximum can step up to 3.5x for four consecutive quarters after a Permitted Acquisition over $25.0 million (at most three times). The excerpt does not say whether a step-up was in effect at October 3, 2026, so the 3.0x limit is reported. Net leverage ratios that only set the interest margin or fees are excluded.
